_timing: No narration yet. Each beat is the larger of the time it needs to finish animating and the time it takes to read, plus a 22-frame hold. This is a floor, not considered pacing — measure a real read and switch this topic to voiceCuts.

beats.note: The line is repeated everywhere, usually credited to Gloria Mark of UC Irvine.
Gallup Business Journal, June 2006. A blogger who traced it in 2023 found the number in three interviews with Mark, and no printed paper containing it.
Mark told Gallup interrupted work was resumed on average in 23 minutes and 15 seconds, with about two other tasks in between.
Mark said her team shadowed 36 managers, analysts, developers, engineers and project leaders. Gallup's page names no paper.

beats.context: Average time before interrupted work was resumed, with other tasks first. Not a measured brain recovery time.

beats.note: In Mark's 2008 experiment they finished sooner but reported more stress, according to a blog and Silicon Canals. Neither page gives the sample size.

beats.text: The number measures the detour. It was never a stopwatch on your brain.
